meta.name: ArchiveAuto vehicle catalog
sources: Cars, vans and trucks 1995-2024: "US Car Models Data" by Abhishek (github.com/abhionlyone/us-car-models-data), licensed CC BY 4.0. US-market data; body style mapped to car/van/truck.
2025: models present in 2024 are carried forward (a few known endings removed), so 2025 may include models that were not sold that year.
Philippine-market cars, vans, trucks and all motorcycles: authored for this project from general knowledge. Years are approximate model-line availability.
meta.note: This catalog is a suggestion list only. The app never blocks a make/model that is not in it.
